description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for transactional state storage in Orleans using xUnit testing framework. It provides various test method overrides for testing transactional behaviors such as load, confirm, cancel, replace, and batch operations, all designed for use within the Orleans actor framework.

classes.name: TransactionalStateStorageTestRunnerxUnit`1
classes.description: An abstract generic test runner class providing a framework for testing transactional state storage in Orleans with xUnit. It includes setup via constructors and various test method overrides.

methods.name: TransactionalStateStorageTestRunnerxUnit`1
